verdicts.reason: A keeps the design recognisable: the yellow headline box, the photo and the thin frame survive. But it is a tiny narrow strip in the middle of a wide white canvas, so the headline is very small, the photo is cropped and the sides are dead empty. A stray yellow block is clipped at the top. B is broken: the photo and headline are thumbnail-sized and stranded in the lower left, the canvas is mostly blank, and there are orphaned tick marks and an empty outlined box on the right plus a stray yellow sliver. It does not read as the same design.
